title: Android TWA packaging: custom app icon assets and manifest wiring

requirements.summary: Add the required Android app icon PNG assets under frontend public generated assets with exact manifest filenames.
acceptanceCriteria: The files `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png` exist in the repo.
Loading `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png` in the browser returns HTTP 200 and displays valid PNG images.

file_operations.description: Add the generated 192x192 square Android app icon PNG asset at the exact required path/filename: `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png`.
Add the generated 512x512 square Android app icon PNG asset at the exact required path/filename: `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png`.

requirements.summary: Ensure the PWA manifest references the custom Android icons using the required generated asset URLs.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest` contains icon entries for sizes 192x192 and 512x512 pointing to `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png`.
The manifest remains valid JSON and is served at `/manifest.webmanifest`.

file_operations.description: Confirm (and if necessary, update) the manifest `icons` array to include entries for sizes `192x192` and `512x512` with `src` exactly set to `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png`, keeping the manifest valid JSON.

requirements.summary: Update the Android TWA build guide to explicitly instruct Bubblewrap icon prompt values and include a pre-build HTTP 200 verification checklist.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md` includes the exact icon URL paths `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png` in the steps/checklist.
The guide clearly states to use the 512x512 icon URL when Bubblewrap requests the icon, and to ensure the manifest icon URLs are accessible before building.

file_operations.description: Update the documentation to: (1) explicitly list the exact icon URL paths `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png`, (2) state clearly that Bubblewrap's icon prompt should use the 512x512 icon URL, and (3) add a short verification checklist that confirms `/manifest.webmanifest` and both icon URLs return HTTP 200 before building APK/AAB.
